items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: That's a good player too, Bill. Tony can play.

ctx.x: Yeah, 1955. In Boston. That's the time George didn't make it up there, did he? No, we had, how do you call it, Perrano. And what? Tony Perrano. Tony Perrano, yeah. Then George got seconded in the yard.

That's a good player too, Bill. Tony can play. But I don't know, I don't know, that's something that George Lewis, that guy can play some kind of it, I swear. I can't find nobody to match it. Man, George, George is, it's that you don't know, but George is the greatest. I think, I put George with any of them, I'm trying to put him with any of them. He really is great, he just don't know, but he is, he's great. And I like about it, he's a man, he don't knock nobody else, don't make no fun of nobody. And when he…
